note: P9 Phase 1 — Discovery & Requirements only. No implementation is authorised by this document. IMPLEMENTED, VERIFIED and APPROVED remain three independent axes. Nothing here is self-approved.
roadmap_objective: Build a real SEO subsystem (legacy has none — only a phantom dependency).
roadmap_forbidden: shipping without a pre-deployment audit step
inventing LCP or INP numeric thresholds (CONF-001)
modifying legacy artefacts (legacy diff must remain 0)
writing machine-global state or external files
roadmap_acceptance: every listed dimension has a check or an explicit N/A rationale
pre-deployment audit step is executable and produces deterministic evidence
disabling SEO subsystem does not break core builds (advisory rollback)
roadmap_verification: SEO validator + audit report as evidence
roadmap_rollback: advisory; disabling must not break builds

standing_bounds.P5: PARTIALLY_SATISFIED — tracked partial dependency; no runtime capability installation
standing_bounds.CONF-001: UNRESOLVED — no LCP/INP numeric thresholds invented; CWV handled via verified CLS + explicit documented N/A rationale for unretrieved metrics

P8.p9_dependency: P8 provides the content and section model (domain/cms/model.py), asset picker (domain/cms/assets.py), and publishing workflow. P9 SEO derives metadata, headings, and asset metadata from P8 content without coupling layout to presentation.

P5.remaining_gap: staleness monitor (report-only) is PARTIAL; install leg intentionally absent per D-P6-2
P5.p9_dependency: P9 does not depend on capability installation or the staleness monitor. P9 depends on project-local selection and provenance records. Tracked as a partial dependency per User authorization.

P7.p9_dependency: P9 state must remain project-local (domain/seo/ or sps2/), isolated, and rollback-safe per P7 memory layout governance.

candidates.relevance: Implementation language for SEO validator, audit tool, and metadata generators
candidates.notes: Standard library modules (html.parser, urllib.parse, json, xml.etree.ElementTree, re, hashlib) suffice for all SEO parsing, schema generation, sitemap creation, and auditing without external dependencies.

candidates.evidence: sps2/research/cache.json — CLS verified verbatim; LCP and INP thresholds not observed (CONF-001)
candidates.notes: Cannot be selected for numeric LCP/INP verification. CWV dimension in P9 will verify CLS and document an explicit N/A rationale for unobserved metrics per CONF-001.

candidates.evidence: sps2/capability/registry.json — blocked behind gates F and K; promotion decision NOT_PROMOTED
candidates.notes: Remains DEFERRED. P9 builds a clean, new, evidence-backed SEO 2.0 subsystem from scratch, not a port of CAP-P03-005.

technology_assessment.discovery_summary: Legacy SPS has no working SEO skill — .sps/architecture/SPS2-MIGRATION-MATRIX.md line 40 confirms the legacy router referenced a phantom dependency ('no skill exists', disposition REWRITE). P2 research (sps2/research/P2-CMS-SEO-AUDIT.md) confirmed Google Search Central (SRC-016) and web.dev (SRC-017) guidelines: XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicalization, structured data (JSON-LD), headings, and CLS <= 0.1 are verified. All P9 components will be designed from first principles using Python stdlib.

requirements.title: Metadata and canonical URL engine
requirements.objective: Generate and validate technical SEO page metadata, title tags, descriptions, and canonical URLs from content models.
acceptance_criteria: Page title tag generated with length constraints (recommended 50-60 characters) and uniqueness check
Meta description generated with length constraints (recommended 120-160 characters)
Canonical URL is strictly absolute, lowercase-normalized, and handles query parameters deterministically
Self-referencing canonical URLs are enforced on canonical pages
Missing title, missing description, or duplicate titles across pages are flagged as audit errors

verification.verifier: metadata generator unit tests + canonical validator test suite

security_implications: Metadata values derived from user content must be HTML-entity escaped to prevent tag injection
Canonical URLs must be validated against SSRF/open-redirect risks

requirements.title: Robots and XML sitemap governance
requirements.objective: Provide deterministic robots.txt and XML sitemap generation, indexing directives, and validation.
acceptance_criteria: robots.txt generator supports User-agent groups, Disallow, Allow, and Sitemap directive references
XML sitemap generator produces valid sitemap.xml conforming to sitemaps.org 0.9 schema
Only published, canonical, indexable URLs are included in sitemaps (no 404s, redirects, or noindex pages)
Meta robots directives (noindex, nofollow, noarchive) are supported at page level and validated against robots.txt to prevent conflicts
Sitemap index generation supported if URL count exceeds threshold

verification.verifier: robots.txt syntax validator + XML sitemap schema validator

security_implications: robots.txt must not disclose sensitive or private administrative paths
Sitemap XML generator must use defused/safe XML parsing to prevent XXE

requirements.title: Structured data (JSON-LD) and social graph engine
requirements.objective: Generate and validate schema.org JSON-LD structured data and Open Graph / Twitter Card social metadata.
acceptance_criteria: JSON-LD generator produces valid schema.org objects (e.g., WebPage, Article, Organization, BreadcrumbList)
Structured data is validated for required schema.org fields and syntactically valid JSON-LD format
Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:url, og:image, og:type) are generated and validated
Twitter Card tags (twitter:card, twitter:title, twitter:description, twitter:image) are generated and validated
Invalid schema types or missing required entity properties trigger audit warnings

verification.verifier: JSON-LD schema validation suite + social graph contract tests

security_implications: JSON-LD output must be properly serialized to prevent script escape vulnerabilities in <script type='application/ld+json'>

requirements.title: On-page structural hierarchy and internal linking
requirements.objective: Validate document heading hierarchy, semantic structure, and internal link integrity.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one H1 element is enforced per page
Heading levels do not skip levels (e.g., H2 directly to H4 is flagged)
Internal links are extracted and resolved against the known route/content graph
Broken internal links (pointing to non-existent content or sections) are flagged as errors
Generic anchor text (e.g., 'click here', 'read more') is flagged as advisory warnings

verification.verifier: HTML heading parser test + link graph resolution tests

security_implications: HTML parser must be robust against deeply nested malicious HTML payloads

requirements.title: Media and image SEO integration
requirements.objective: Ensure all media assets meet image SEO standards and layout stability requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Every element must have a non-empty alt attribute unless marked explicitly decorative (aria-hidden)
Image filenames must be descriptive and hyphen-separated (validated against raw ID hashes)
Image elements specify explicit width and height (or aspect-ratio) to prevent Cumulative Layout Shift
Integration with P8 asset picker ensures media records provide required SEO metadata fields
security_implications: Alt text must be plain text and sanitized against attribute injection

requirements.title: URL architecture, redirects, and pagination
requirements.objective: Validate URL architecture, trailing slash consistency, redirect chains, and pagination structure.
acceptance_criteria: Consistent URL slug architecture enforced (lowercase, hyphen-delimited, no trailing slash ambiguity)
Redirect taxonomy validation detects and flags redirect loops and redirect chains (>1 hop)
Temporary (302/307) vs permanent (301/308) redirect status codes are verified according to intent
Paginated collections enforce deterministic canonicalization (canonical to page 1 or self-referential with rel='prev'/'next')

verification.verifier: URL normalization test + redirect graph validator

security_implications: Redirect targets must not allow open redirects to untrusted external domains

requirements.title: Core Web Vitals dimension and CONF-001 boundary preservation
requirements.objective: Provide layout-shift stability verification while strictly preserving the CONF-001 boundary.
acceptance_criteria: CLS verified threshold from SRC-017 is encoded and verified (CLS <= 0.1 good, > 0.25 poor)
Static layout shift prevention checks (e.g. required image dimensions, font-display) are enforced
No LCP or INP numeric threshold is invented, inferred, or introduced anywhere in code or config
Unobserved CWV dimensions (LCP, INP) carry an explicit, documented N/A rationale per P9 acceptance criteria
CONF-001 remains UNRESOLVED and is recorded as such in all P9 reports and evidence

verification.verifier: CLS threshold unit test + regex scan asserting zero invented LCP/INP thresholds

security_implications: Encoding unverified numbers breaches governance and compromises evidence integrity

requirements.title: Specialized dimensions modular evaluation (i18n, local, ecommerce)
requirements.objective: Support modular checks for internationalization, local SEO, and ecommerce, or provide explicit N/A rationales.
acceptance_criteria: If multilingual: hreflang tags, x-default, and bidirectional hreflang links are validated
If local business: LocalBusiness structured data, address, geo-coordinates, and openingHours are validated
If ecommerce: Product and Offer structured data with price, currency, and availability are validated
If a specialized dimension is not applicable to the site, an explicit machine-readable N/A rationale is recorded
Every dimension listed in roadmap P9 is guaranteed either a verified check or an explicit N/A rationale

verification.verifier: dimension completeness validator verifying check-or-NA coverage across all dimensions

security_implications: Hreflang URLs must be validated against destination domain spoofing

requirements.title: Mandatory pre-deployment SEO audit tool and evidence generator
requirements.objective: Build the pre-deployment SEO audit tool that validates all dimensions and produces deterministic audit evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Audit tool executes all defined dimension checks against pages, sitemaps, and content models
Audit outputs structured, machine-readable JSON and human-readable Markdown audit reports
Produces valid SPS 2.0 evidence record (EV-SEO-*) with timestamps, counts, pass/fail results, and exit codes
Roadmap forbidden rule is strictly enforced: deployment readiness (P13) must require a clean pre-deployment SEO audit
Audit differentiates between CRITICAL/ERROR (blocks deployment) and WARNING/ADVISORY (informational)

verification.verifier: CLI audit execution test + evidence schema validation

security_implications: Audit tool must run project-locally without network dependencies or transmission of site data

requirements.title: Advisory rollback and project-local stdlib isolation
requirements.objective: Ensure SEO 2.0 implementation is project-local, stdlib-only, leaves legacy diff zero, and has advisory rollback.
acceptance_criteria: All SEO implementation code resides in domain/seo/ and sps2/tools/ without modifying sps2/core/
No third-party packages, CLIs, or npm modules installed (Python stdlib only)
Zero modifications to legacy repository files except the eight content-and-mode-pinned updater files authorized by DEC-7301; every other legacy change fails closed

Outside the four owned P10 Home dependencies approved by DEC-7302, disabling or removing the SEO subsystem does not break other core SPS 2.0 builds; P9 removal is a coordinated architectural operation and no longer guarantees that Home remains buildable until those dependencies are retired or migrated
Rollback rehearsal proves deletion of domain/seo/ leaves core validators passing

verification.verifier: legacy diff validator + stdlib dependency scan + rollback rehearsal

security_implications: No machine-global state writes; complete project isolation per P7 governance

phase_1_boundary.next_phase_required: User approval of P9 Phase 1 requirements before Phase 2 (Architecture, Schemas & Threat Model) may begin
phase_1_boundary.approval_required: User must approve: (1) the 10 P9 requirements, (2) the CWV/CONF-001 explicit N/A handling strategy, (3) the pre-deployment audit gating mechanism, and (4) the standing governance bounds.

unresolved_questions.question: What is the structural boundary and location for the SEO 2.0 subsystem?
unresolved_questions.context: SPS 2.0 architecture specifies domain/ subsystems (SPS2-REPOSITORY-ARCHITECTURE.md line 59: domain/seo/). CMS content lives in domain/cms/. SEO needs to inspect content, generate metadata, and audit pages.
options: Place SEO engine and models in domain/seo/, with a clean import interface from domain/cms/ and audit CLI in sps2/tools/
Embed SEO metadata generation directly into domain/cms/ content models, keeping only the audit tool in domain/seo/
Implement SEO purely as a standalone post-build audit CLI in sps2/tools/seo_audit.py
unresolved_questions.recommended: Option 1: Dedicated domain/seo/ subsystem with clean API and sps2/tools/ integration

unresolved_questions.question: How should Core Web Vitals (CWV) be verified under the CONF-001 boundary?
unresolved_questions.context: CLS thresholds are verified (<= 0.1 good, > 0.25 poor). LCP and INP numeric thresholds remain NOT_OBSERVED (CONF-001). Roadmap P9 acceptance requires 'every listed dimension has a check or an explicit N/A rationale'.
options: Implement automated CLS verification and static layout-shift prevention rules (e.g. image dimensions), while recording an explicit machine-readable N/A rationale for unretrieved LCP/INP thresholds
Mark CWV entirely as N/A in the pre-deployment audit until a dedicated performance testing phase
Define qualitative heuristic checks for LCP/INP (e.g., verifying hero image preloading tags exist) without numeric thresholds
unresolved_questions.recommended: Option 1: Verified CLS check + static shift prevention + explicit N/A rationale for unobserved metrics per CONF-001

unresolved_questions.question: How should the mandatory pre-deployment audit gate be enforced in CI and build workflows?
unresolved_questions.context: Roadmap P9 explicitly forbids 'shipping without a pre-deployment audit step'. Rollback is described as 'advisory; disabling must not break builds'.
options: Enforce pre-deployment audit as an advisory report by default, but make the generated EV-SEO-* record a mandatory prerequisite in P13 (Deployment Readiness)
Audit tool exits non-zero on CRITICAL SEO defects, halting deployment scripts unless an explicit --bypass flag is passed
Dual-mode: CLI exits non-zero on CRITICAL failures in deployment mode, and produces EV-SEO-* evidence records required for Level 4 deployment sign-off
unresolved_questions.recommended: Option 3: Dual-mode CLI (deterministic exit code + formal evidence artifact generation)

mandatory_controls: Output encoding: all generated meta tags, JSON-LD, and HTML attributes must escape untrusted user input
SSRF prevention: canonical URL, sitemap URL, and redirect validators must prohibit internal/loopback IP targets
Safe XML handling: sitemap parsing/generation must protect against XML entity expansion (XXE)
Advisory rollback: disabling the SEO subsystem must never break core site builds or framework execution
CONF-001 invariant: zero invented LCP or INP thresholds in any SEO artefact
